state:
Goal `core-xml-writer`: `attribute`, `comment`, `cdata`, `instruction` and `doctype` of `Core\Xml\Writer` have all their feature proofs, and their cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs` are in plain words.
`doctype` now refuses a second declaration (new writer slot `typed`, `DOCTYPE_SLOT`), pinned by `tests/conformance/core/xml-a-writer-writes-at-most-one-document-type-declaration.nvst`.
Five Writer members still owe examples, hostile, perf and a Rust test: `startDocument`, `endDocument`, `startElement`, `endElement`, `content`.
Gap `nvs-stdlib/an-xml-writer-holds-a-string-per-piece` still stands: keep writer attacks and benches under about 500,000 pieces, or mark them with that gap.
Any later edit to `xml.rs` code stales the whole `Core\Xml*` perf set again: finish with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Xml' --group 'Core\Xml\Node' --group 'Core\Xml\Reader' --group 'Core\Xml\Writer'`.
`bun nv try` runs the pipeline's `covws` binary, which does not have a fix made this session; run it with `NVS_BIN=target/debug/nvs.exe` after `cargo build --bin nvs`, and bless the same way.
